content.text: Skip to content Home Earth Day Events Earth Day Events Celebrating Earth Day’s 56th Anniversary! The first Earth Day took place on April 22, 1970, and brought together millions of Americans from all walks of life to create the modern environmental movement. Since then, Earth Day has evolved into the largest civic event on Earth, bringing together billions of people across 192 countries! After 55 years, trash continues to be a social epidemic. Join in and be part of the solution here in Marin by playing an active role in improving your community and protecting our waterways! For those of you that won’t be available to join in on one of the organized activities, make every day Earth Day by picking up litter on your walk around the neighborhood or community! Earth Day Projects for 2026 Below are the projects available for public participation. You can zoom in and out to see all of the projects and click for details. Have an open (or even closed) event that’s not on our map yet? Contact us with the details so we can add it. Closed events will be listed as not open for public participation. Comments are closed.
